thread:
James: Quick sync — API bindings v30 deploy planned for tomorrow 2026-04-02 10:00 PST. This is intended to be non-breaking server-side, but we need to validate client fallbacks, docs, and rollback readiness. Can smoke owners + client comms own? TL;DR rollout plan below.

Tia: I can own smoke runs. Plan: staging -> canary -> prod. Smoke checklist: auth token flows, streaming end-to-end, param mapping (new/optional params), embeddings endpoint sanity. I'll post a short results gist.

Omar: I'll own rollback. If errors >5% or 99p latency +500ms, we'll revert proxy and pin clients to v29. Rollback snippet in runbook:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/api-bindings --to-revision=<prev-rev>
# then flip feature flag:
# curl -X POST https://infra.internal/flags -d '{"bindings_v30_enabled":false}'
```
I'll have those commands ready.

Lucy: Docs + changelog: I'll update the SDK docs and add a migration note with code examples. ETA EOD today. Also suggest a short customer advisory about the change and how to opt-out if needed.

Maya: Client comms — I'll draft a short email + GH release note and a snippet showing the small migration pattern. Will send for PM + legal approval this afternoon.

James: Smoke owners @Tia @Omar please confirm POC in #incidents during the window. Also need a CR ping for the proxy config PR — @Lucy can you finalize the last comment?

Tia: Confirmed — I'll be on call during the rollout window. Will run the curated prompt set and watch the perf dashboard for latency regressions. I'll paste smoke results here.

Omar: Confirmed on rollback. I'll watch QPS and 95/99p latency and coordinate any traffic flip with infra. If we need to fallback, I'll execute the runbook and post timestamps.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment v30 to prod at 2026-04-02T17:00:00Z (10:00 PST). Canary policy: 10% for 10m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. Health checks enabled.

Lucy: Proxy PR is merged to release branch and tagged. Quick sanity in staging: `curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.dev/v30/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns 200 and response shape matches v29.

James: Preflight checklist: smoke owners assigned, rollback plan documented, client note drafted, monitoring dashboards pinned, PR merged. Anything missing?

Maya: Add: ensure webhook handlers and SDK version gates accept v30 tokens (token mapping). I'll coordinate with eng-infra to make logs export to the retention bucket during the canary for quicker traces.

Tia: :thumbsup: all set from my side. Will paste the smoke logs and quick pass/fail in this thread.

Omar: Also will run a compatibility script 30m before canary: `python tools/check_compat.py --version v30 --shallow`. Added to CI so results are visible.

James: :partyparrot: Great. Post-deploy owner for verification: Lucy — can you do the 30-min follow-up and file a short summary to #release-notes?

Lucy: Yes, I'll run post-deploy checks and upload a short verification note + any follow-up tickets.

James: Thanks all — I'll start the deployment as scheduled if there are no objections by EOD.
